name: Wheat bran
short: In irritable bowel syndrome trials, bran was worse than placebo for wind-related symptoms and less well tolerated than another fibre. No interaction data were found.
text: In a placebo-controlled crossover trial in 80 people with irritable bowel syndrome, bran fibre (type not stated) was significantly less effective than placebo for wind-related symptoms. In a randomised open trial in 188 adults with irritable bowel syndrome, wheat bran was less well tolerated than partially hydrolysed guar gum, and about half of those assigned to bran switched to the other fibre at four weeks. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
